description: Defines the PersonState class used for representing and applying changes to a person's state in an Orleans-based application, including serialization attributes and apply methods for different events.

classes.name: PersonState
classes.description: A serializable class representing the state of a person, with properties for first name, last name, gender, and marital status, and methods to apply various events to update its state.

methods.name: Apply(PersonRegistered @event)
methods.description: Updates the person's first name, last name, and gender based on the PersonRegistered event.

methods.name: Apply(PersonMarried @event)
methods.description: Sets the IsMarried property to true when a PersonMarried event is applied.

methods.name: Apply(PersonLastNameChanged @event)
methods.description: Updates the LastName property based on the PersonLastNameChanged event.
